title: HashedNet virtual FFN with a learned Givens input View
dataset: scikit-learn load_digits, fixed 8x8 grayscale digit features and labels
model: Two-layer MLP: 64 inputs -> 128 ReLU hidden units -> 10 logits; compressed object is first FFN weight matrix
hypothesis: A 32-angle block-Givens coordinate on the input features will reduce harmful parameter collisions in a 4x HashedNet FFN enough to improve test accuracy over ordinary hashing, while using no more than 1.10x the native hash payload and outperforming byte-near diagonal and rank-one residual controls.
physical_object: One 2,048-value hashed parameter table for an 8,192-weight first-layer FFN matrix; second layer and biases are shared/paid normally
mirror_coordinate: Thirty-two learned adjacent-pair Givens angles applied to the input feature coordinates before the hashed FFN matrix
task: Ten-class supervised handwritten digit recognition; each run uses a stratified 75/25 train/test split
methods: HashedNet plus 32 learned Givens input angles (Mirror)
HashedNet plus 64 learned diagonal input scales

hashing.mapping: Uniform bucket and independent +/-1 sign sampled from NumPy PCG64 using a deterministic run-derived seed; mapping is regenerated from the paid 32-bit seed and fixed implementation.

training.training_examples: Stratified 75% split; deterministic minibatch sampling per method/run seed
training.initialization: Dense Kaiming; hash table Kaiming-equivalent normal; Mirror angles zero; diagonal scales one; rank-one factors small Gaussian

development.selection: No hyperparameter grid. Architecture, bucket counts, 800 updates, optimizer and success thresholds are fixed before training.

fresh.data_splits: Same fixed dataset, independent stratified partitions keyed by fresh seeds
fresh.open_rule: Run all fresh splits only if both development seeds satisfy the complete frozen Mirror quality/storage/control gate. No fresh results may select or alter settings.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes after load/serialize roundtrip
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Hash indices/signs are regenerated from the paid seed and the committed hash algorithm; only the seed and code/schema are free-standing paid state.

report: serialized-model inference wall time and examples/s

success_gate: Both dev seeds: Mirror accuracy is at least +1.0 percentage point over 2,048-bucket HashedNet and within 2.0 points of dense; Mirror payload <=1.10x native 2,048-bucket bytes; and neither diagonal-gate nor rank-one-residual control matches/beats Mirror within 1.0 point at <=1.10x Mirror bytes. Fresh splits confirm only after this gate.
failure_gate: Any dev quality/byte/control miss or any Mirror gain explained by a byte-near simple control is FAIL for the registered Mirror claim. Fresh remains sealed unless the complete dev gate passes.
boundaries: One small image dataset and one compressed FFN matrix; not language-model capacity evidence
A 2,048-bucket table creates hash collisions; virtual connections are not counted as independent capacity
Weight projection error is diagnostic; held-out accuracy is the primary functional quality
Fixed-update learning efficiency is not a near-convergence capacity claim
A Mirror view is only credited if the matched native gate and low-rank controls do not explain it
